title: Scam
body: Don’t download this. I’ve been trying to deactivate the automatic subscription renewal and they are still demanding money. It’s a scam, just avoid it.

title: Scam! Beware
body: I have been charged twice without an explanation, if i didn’t notice and blocked my credit card i could have been charged who knows how many times

author: Tidde88

title: Una splendida app
body: Uno strumento che trovo rasserenante e stimolante
author: Maxorius

title: Additional details
body:
I’ve started working with Clarify for a short period, and I believe if there were some small features I would never leave the app, what I usually am doing these days.
The first thing is that writing our to-do list is not quite easy. It needs to be modified one by one after recording and it doesn’t have space for sub-divisions. For an ADHD person I need to break each task into smaller chunks, so it’s been frustrating. Then there’s this thing that in Deep Work room, I don’t have the option to pause a work, go to something else, (I mean while I’m on a break I can do something else on my list, right?) and then get back to my previous task and resuming my timer. The timer restarts every time and my time is not recorded as it was. Not very good for a reward deprived person. I mean if the problems I’m mentioning are actually incorrect, that’d be a shame because I couldn’t find them.
author: Yasminset

title: Confusionaria e ingannevole
body: Questa app non è adatta a persone con ADHD: l’interfaccia è troppo colorata e l’esperienza utente è confusionaria. Inoltre, il sistema di abbonamento è poco chiaro e definibile quasi fraudolento. A differenza della loro altra app, Fabulous, che permette di gestire l’abbonamento tramite Apple, qui bisogna farlo direttamente dal sito. Ciò significa che, anche se disattivi l’abbonamento tramite la prima app, continuerai a essere addebitato dopo il periodo di prova. Trovo che questo sia un approccio poco trasparente e ingannevole.
author: Chi sono ?

title: Andate sul sito e cancellate l’abbonamento o prova gratuita
body: Anche se su Apple esce che l’abbonamento è stato annullato vi sarà addebitato 39,99€ perché non avrete “disdetto sul sito, risulterà come se aveste fatto l’abbonamento sul sito anche se non è così e dovrete cancellare da lì. Ho chiesto un rimborso mi è arrivata l’email dicendo che mi avevano rimborsato ma non vedo ancora u soldi sulla carta
author: sarajsb

title: App and Platform makes hard to manage subscription
body: Ended up being charged 70€ without even using this app for more than 2 days because it’s subscription doesn’t appear on Apple App Store but it’s in their own website. Now, knowing that ADHD makes us forget things, I use the App Store to manage all my apps subscription and haven’t see this app on that list made me think I had already unsubscribed. Basically they use what they know about adhd to trick people. Also: app design is bad.
author: DELTA-ZERO-3
